newsitem.title: USA: MotivePower unit wins $6 mln contract.
newsitem.headline: MotivePower unit wins $6 mln contract.

text.p: MotivePower Industries Inc said Friday its Boise Locomotive Co unit had won a $6 million contract to build three commuter locomotives and supply various spare parts for the San Joaquin Regional Rail Commission.
Production will begin immediately, the company said, with delivery scheduled for the third quarter of 1997.
The Rail Commission has an option to buy another six locomotives within the next 12 months, MotivePower said.
The locomotives will be used for a new commuter rail service, slated to begin in early 1998, from Stockton to San Jose, Calif., the company added.
